natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, rev +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence shows that shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction improve early adoption. Run a standard, guarded simplification test with qualified activation and downstream revenue-quality metrics—not completion alone—as success criteria. Avoid promotional pricing because the prior discount increased signups and revenue but materially reduced retention.
